notes: Covers the 47-inch Vizio GV47L FHDTV10A LCD TV. The manual's shared spare parts list also holds GV42L and GV46L items, which are not claimed here; where its lists disagree (scaler type, fuse designators) the spec names the list used.

gaps: Section 7.13 gives MP7722 as 2 x 10 W into 8 ohm and MP7782 as 20 W BTL into 8 ohm at 24 V; the audio board list describes them as 2*20W and 50W, and MPS's MP7722 page says 2 x 20 W into 4 ohm. w follows section 7.13 (this TV).
No MP7782 datasheet was readable (LCSC and Mouser copies were not PDFs; the MPS listing found was a different part, MP7748), so MP7782 rests on the manual alone.

The scaler at U11 is MT8206AG/BD-L (0430-7044-4999) in the main board list, but MT8202AG/BD-L (043070428999) in the spare parts list; the main board block diagram says MT8202 and the text says MTK8206.
TDA8946AJ (U24) is only in the spare parts list and the block diagram label. The main board and audio board component lists do not contain it, and section 7.5 routes audio to MP7722 and MP7782.
Fuses: the main board SMD list has F1 3 A and F2, F3 1.5 A; the spare parts list instead gives F1 F4 F6 and F1 F2 F3 for the 1.5 A part (qty 3 each) and F4 for the 3 A part. The board list is used.
The system block diagram text describes a panel inverter lighting lamps, but the panel list has an LED backlight and no inverter board, so the inverter claim was dropped.
The 20 W speaker (0335-2008-0000) is not called a woofer in the parts list; the spec page lists one 20 W sub woofer and the right box list has woofer cover parts.
The LED backlight reads '18*50' with qty 1; the LED and strip counts are not stated, so none is claimed.
The power board's internal parts and output currents are not in the manual, so no b:smps_board parts are claimed.
The manual has no date, so no years are given. The keypad/IR board has no part number for this model in the lists read, so it is not claimed.
method: Service manual for the VIZIO GV47L FHDTV10A, PDF on the Internet Archive (item Vizio_GV47L_FHDTV10A_LCD_TV, 164 PDF pages), read as text with the research tool; page 95 (main board block diagram) rendered and looked at.
PDF pages used: 5 and 6 (specification), 46 (section 7.13), 93 and 95 (block diagrams), 96 (spare parts list), 100, 108, 109 and 112 (panel, bezel and acoustic box lists).
PDF pages used (cont.): 117 to 121 (audio board SMD list), 124 (main board manual-insertion list), 148, 150 and 159 (main board SMD lists), 163 and 164 (display board list).
MPS product page for MP7722 and NXP product page for TDA8946AJ opened with WebFetch; both open, name the chip and need no login. Their figures are not used on the parts.
No FCC filing was used for this model.

comps.spec: LED backlight, part 0980-0700-0030, listed in the panel assembly as 'LED BACKLIGHT 18*50 LYSB-4916W/SY 580mm'
Power board assembly DPS-475AP, part 0500-0507-0260. The manual says it turns 100-240 V AC 50/60 Hz into 5 V, 12 V and 24 V DC. The set's power consumption is given as 400 W max, 3 W max when off
Speaker assembly 8 ohm 10 W, part 0335-1008-0090, one in each of the left and right acoustic boxes
Speaker 8 ohm 20 W, part 0335-2008-0000, in the right acoustic box beside the woofer cover and woofer isolation sheet parts; the spec page lists one 20 W sub woofer

Main board assembly 3647-0012-0150 (HDCP). Its lists include the MT5351AG decoder SoC (DU9), MT5112BD demodulator (DU8), MT8293AE-L HDMI receiver (U19), WM8776SEFT audio codec (U23) and a scaler at U11 (MT8206AG/BD-L in the board's own list; the spare parts list says MT8202AG/BD-L)
TV tuner module DTVS205CH201A (part 0980-0103-3060, designator DTU1), in the main board's manual-insertion list and on its block diagram
Audio board assembly 3647-0012-0137. Its SMD list has the MP7722 (U7) and MP7782 (U8) amplifier ICs and six NJM4558 dual op amps (U1 to U6)
Display board assembly 3647-0012-0156, listed in the front bezel assembly. Its SMD list includes a QT1080-ISG IC (UD1)
47-inch TFT LCD module LC470WU01-SLC1 (LG.Philips), part 0211-0470-0461, 1920 x 1080 pixels
SMD fuse 125 V 1.5 A, part 018511520073, at F2 and F3 in the main board SMD list
SMD fuse 125 V 3 A, part 018513020073, at F1 in the main board SMD list (F4 in the spare parts list)
MP7722DF-LF-Z dual-channel class-D audio amplifier IC (part 0430-7043-4620), U7 on the audio board; section 7.13 gives 2 x 10 W into 8 ohm from a 24 V supply
MP7782DF-LF-Z mono BTL class-D audio amplifier IC (part 0430-7043-3620), U8 on the audio board; section 7.13 gives 20 W into 8 ohm from a 24 V supply

IC TDA8946AJ, 17-pin DIP (part 043040133109), designator U24 in the spare parts list; the main board block diagram labels U24 as the audio amp. NXP's product page describes the chip as a dual BTL audio amplifier
DDR SDRAM on the main board: two NT5DS16M16CS-5T (16M x 16, DU15 and DU16) and two V58C2128164SBI5 (8M x 16, U13 and U14)
